topics.name: Migration Map
topics.purpose: Define explicit migration from legacy repository artifacts into Contract Format 1.4 identities, including move, split, merge-by-reference, retire and supersede actions without silently discarding semantics.

semantics.source_rule: Legacy source identity/path is recorded as migration provenance only.
semantics.target_rule: Every retained semantic surface maps to an explicit 1.4 canonical identity.
semantics.retire_rule: Retired semantics require explicit reason and evidence that they are obsolete/duplicated/non-canonical.
semantics.merge_rule: Merge-by-reference removes duplication while preserving original semantic owners.
semantics.split_rule: One legacy artifact may map to multiple 1.4 contracts when it mixed distinct semantic owners/dimensions.
semantics.gap_rule: Unresolved legacy semantics remain visible migration gaps.

invariants.rule: Repository activation, migration state, validation state and replacement decisions are explicit and machine-readable.

hard_gates.condition: migration target inferred only from new directory location
multiple semantic owners merged into one without explicit ownership reconciliation

references.purpose: Migration maps legacy sources into the new assembled repository inventory.
